evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Prevent unintended breaking CLI changes according to the repository's compatibility rules.
intent.acceptance: Correctly identify all relevant breaking changes in the source-required preceding 24 hours under the contemporaneous repository rules, and establish their remediation or explicitly approved breaking-release treatment. Completeness, actual user behavior, approvals, migration sufficiency and full historical coverage are not inferred from issue closure or merge.

evidence.opportunity: The documented plain top-level block-form app: mapping with ordinary space indentation and a supported app-id/private-key payload. Quoted/flow/duplicate keys, all YAML forms, compiler execution and unrelated migration behavior are not established.
filters: Native AST and unchanged production wiring
evidence.collection: Immutable original API packets, Git blob verification and locally authored Go AST oracle; target code is never executed

window.interval: Half-open delivery periods; each restoration belongs once to its actual repair-commit timestamp, never repeated snapshot stock.

model.architecture: Acquire bounded originals once, verify native source facts, allocate disjoint delivery periods and render with the portable skill
model.recommendation: Not rated; full compatibility, safeguards, matched costs and an agreed keep bar are unknown

metrics.name: Verified automatic migration repairs
metrics.formula: Count one top-level app-to-github-app automatic migration repair only when actual single-parent before/after source, native Go AST structure, unchanged production helper/dispatch wiring, the pre-repair independently promised migration and the destination schema establish restored gh aw fix coverage. Count the repair once, not once per YAML field, test, edited file or later observation.

originalAcceptance.formula: Count distinct existing CLI contract cases whose actual repair commit and real parent independently prove a broken existing command, flag, output, exit/default behavior or schema contract is restored, corroborated by an older immutable contract or independent compatibility fixture. Deduplicate repair commit plus affected public contract identity; a title, edit count, migration note or workflow-infrastructure repair is not a CLI restoration.
eligibility: Repair is on immutable bound repository history by cutoff and after actual workflow introduction.
Original issue/PR/run identities are retained; editable markers discover candidates but are not creation receipts.
Native before/after and independently established prior CLI contract prove the specified restoration without executing target code.
Downstream linkage is established separately from native restoration; shared corroboration is not sole causation or receipt-backed attribution.

definition.fullAcceptance: Correctly identify all relevant breaking changes in the source-required preceding 24 hours under the contemporaneous repository rules, and establish their remediation or explicitly approved breaking-release treatment. Completeness, actual user behavior, approvals, migration sufficiency and full historical coverage are not inferred from issue closure or merge.
limitations: Full goal attainment and all-period or all-candidate completeness
Receipt-backed workflow contribution, sole causation and attributable costs
Keep decision without an explicitly agreed native threshold
No count for release notes, major changeset labels, merged PRs, synthetic positives or workflow jq allowance.
The selected report's shallow-history and all-six-findings assertions are not adopted as accurate.
This repair does not restore direct compiler acceptance of deprecated app syntax.
One verified migration condition is not full CLI compatibility, all-window analysis completeness or full workflow attainment.
definition.assessmentPolicy: Explicitly outcome-informed retrospective, after inspecting the retained candidate implementations. Preserve the original source-informed v1 unchanged; this partial does not claim restored acceptance of removed schema fields.

nativeAssessment.authoring: Explicitly outcome-informed retrospective, after inspecting the retained candidate implementations. Preserve the original source-informed v1 unchanged; this partial does not claim restored acceptance of removed schema fields.
nativeAssessment.limitation: Every period without independently verified delivery is null, not measured zero. Full goal acceptance, complete safeguards, receipt-backed attribution, costs and keep decision remain unknown/not rated.

runBinding.limitation: An editable footer links to a verified run; it is not a safe-output creation receipt.

recentComparison.reason: Incomplete, provisional or unverified period evidence.

decision.reason: No agreed native keep bar and review duration.

recentComparison.reason: Fresh complete mature evidence is required for recent movement.

valueReview.limitation: Native outcome evidence and declared contribution are not causal attribution or a monetary return.
